verdict.rationale: Devin's docs explicitly describe taking over in-progress work across all three surfaces: delegating via the web app and taking over in Devin's IDE (devin-docs-5), watching/interacting with commands in its terminal (devin-docs-2, devin-docs-6), jumping in via the Interactive Browser (devin-docs-7), and handing off between local CLI and cloud sessions (devin-docs-3). Community evidence is generally skeptical of Devin's overall autonomy claims but doesn't specifically contest this handoff/takeover mechanic.
